vocal_chain.clip_gain: manual phrase-level clip gain before inserts
vocal_chain.cleanup_eq: high-pass vocal rumble, subtract mud/resonances before brightness
vocal_chain.compression: serial leveling then tone/glue if needed

saturation.plan: generic saturation approximation or manual Logic instruction

vocal_chain.de_ess: after saturation/brightness; target S/T/SH without dulling the whole vocal
vocal_chain.tone_eq: presence/air only after de-ess is stable
vocal_chain.reverb_delay_sends: plate/room plus tempo delay throws at phrase endings
vocal_chain.vocal_bus_trim: trim final vocal bus into beat/master bus without clipping
limitations: Full stereo vocal treatment is heuristic; no isolated vocal control is claimed.

instrumental_chain.broad_eq: broad tonal balance only; avoid surgical claims without stems
instrumental_chain.controlled_saturation: light to medium, checked for harshness
instrumental_chain.width_plan: width only on high-passed upper content
limitations: Stereo-only input cannot provide true kick/bass replacement, true drum rewrite, or guaranteed vocal removal.

stem_chain.drum_bus: kick/snare/hat balance, transient shaping, parallel crush only if controlled
stem_chain.bass_808_bus: mono sub, saturation on upper harmonics, sidechain only when masking occurs
stem_chain.melody_synth_bus: mid cleanup, high-passed width layers, hook clarity rides
stem_chain.vocal_bus: lead/adlib/backing balance if vocal stems are present
stem_chain.pre_master_bus: headroom, no clipping, broad glue only
limitations: Stem mix plan becomes manual guidance until stems are provided.

drum_808_plan.kick: short controlled transient; no extracted reference kick unless owned/cleared
drum_808_plan.808: mono sub, controlled saturation, movement supports hook

synth_width_plan.automation: widen hooks, narrow verses/bridges when useful

master_chain.warning: No aggressive limiting; leave headroom for later mastering.
chain: final limiter only at the end
export verification before any completion claim
